summary: Full E2E for AestheticaMD backup + restore features. Backend pytest (6/6 pass): /api/backup/status admin OK & non-admin 403, /api/backup/run creates valid ZIP (meta.json + per-collection JSON), /api/backup/download streams ZIP with attachment filename, path-traversal guarded (returns 404 for '..%2Fetc' and unknown 'evil.zip'), restore flow (status→awaiting, cancellation_reason cleared, cancellation_history length 1 with 'Cena'; second restore → 400). Frontend Playwright (all pass): Settings /settings shows backup-section with backup-auto-status 'Codzienny automatyczny backup włączony'; backup-run-button creates new row (before=2 → after=3); backup-download-button triggers browser download of fresh timestamped ZIP; backup-delete-<name> removes newly created timestamped backup (daily aestheticamd_YYYY-MM-DD.zip preserved). Restore-via-detail: cancellation-info shows restore-patient-button; after click patient status becomes awaiting, cancellation-history block appears with '15.09.2026 – Cena (termin 2026-08-01)'. Restore-via-list: show-hidden-statuses reveals cancelled patient rows, restore-<id> icon button visible; click restores patient (API confirmed status=awaiting, hist_len=1). All test patients and backup files cleaned up.

issues: Same pre-existing React hydration warnings from ve-dynamic wrapper spans around <option>/<tr>/<tbody> (Dashboard, PatientsList). Cosmetic; likely Emergent visual-editor tooling injection in preview. Does not affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: backup.py: FILE_RE strictly whitelists 'aestheticamd_YYYY-MM-DD[_HHMMSS].zip' — good defense against path traversal (../etc and arbitrary filenames rejected with 404).
backup.py download endpoint writes a temp file then uses BackgroundTask(os.remove) — correct cleanup pattern; ZIP built in-memory then flushed.

backup_scheduler is a simple asyncio while-True with hourly sleep — no jitter/idempotency lock. Two workers could double-write for the same day; has_backup_for_today() guards but there's still a small race. Consider a file lock or naming atomic write (already using os.replace via _write_file — OK).

BackupSection.jsx: 'Utwórz kopię teraz' button disabled when !status?.auto_enabled — good UX. Uses window.confirm for delete (native dialog) — acceptable but Sonner-style modal would be more consistent.
PatientDetail.jsx cancellation-history only rendered when status !== 'cancelled' — correct (hidden while patient still cancelled to avoid duplicate info).
